name: processtask_step_worker
label: Who Can Handle the Current Workflow
description: Track who can handle the current workflow. This feature is used for related queries on workflow-related data and reporting scenarios.

fields.name: processtask_id
fields.description: Work order ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: processtask_step_id
fields.description: Step ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: The unique identifier of the handler, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: user_type
fields.description: Task type, to distinguish step handlers from sub-task handlers, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the processtask_id, processtask_step_id, UUID, user_type fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_processtask_step_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the processtask_step_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_type
indexes.description: Standard index covering the type field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the UUID field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
